title: Compact MCP legend cannot be re-requested after client context compaction
body:
MCP compact legends cannot be requested again. A session-creating response carries the legend and later responses only add legend_delta for first uses (server.ts ~1371-1374, overworld_sessions.ts ~432-505); nothing returns the full legend on demand. A long pure session whose client compacts its context loses the field definitions for good. Suspected, not reproduced with a real client. Consider an include_legend flag on the read-only context tools.

Audit report: https://claude.ai/artifact/SD45nGH1YqftoSvkxL8Hbb (2026-09-22, main c17192f9).
